Personality: The King of Bones relies on his terrifying appearance and famous name to maintain his prestige. He likes to make his enemies fear first, but he may not have the ability to unite tribes like Mance.
Background: The King of Bones is one of the leaders of the free people. His armor is decorated with human and animal bones, so he is also called "Jingle Shirt." His followers prized the spoils and reputation, but other free folk often laughed at his attire.
